preToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'); TS=$(python3 -c 'import time,sys;sys.stdout.write(str(int(time.time()*1000)))' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s000' "$(date +%s)"); SID=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.sessionId // empty' 2>/dev/null); DIR="${HOME}/.copilot-obs/sessions"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; F="${DIR}/${SID:-unknown}.jsonl"; TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolName // empty' 2>/dev/null); ARGS=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolArgs // empty' 2>/dev/null); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' "$INPUT" | jq -c --arg event 'preToolUse' --argjson ts "$TS" '{event:$event,timestamp_ms:$ts,raw:.}' >> "$F"; fi; if [ "$TOOL" = "bash" ] || [ "$TOOL" = "execute" ] || [ "$TOOL" = "shell" ]; then CMD=$(printf '%s' "$ARGS" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qEi 'rm -rf /|sudo rm|format |DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE'; then printf '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Dangerous command blocked by security hook"}'; exit 0; fi; fi; if [ "$TOOL" = "edit" ] || [ "$TOOL" = "create" ] || [ "$TOOL" = "write" ]; then FP=$(printf '%s' "$ARGS" | jq -r '.path // .filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$FP" | grep -qEi '\.env$|\.env\.|secrets|credentials|\.pem$|\.key$'; then printf '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Cannot modify sensitive files"}'; exit 0; fi; fi
preToolUse.powershell: $r='{}'; try{$r=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()}catch{}; if(!$r){$r='{}'}; $ts=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); $p=$(try{$r|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{@{}}); $sid=if($p.sessionId){$p.sessionId}else{'unknown'}; $d=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.copilot-obs\sessions'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){$null=New-Item $d -ItemType Directory -Force}; @{event='preToolUse';timestamp_ms=$ts;raw=$p}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 10|Add-Content (Join-Path $d "$sid.jsonl"); $tool=$p.toolName; $args_str=$p.toolArgs; if($tool -in @('bash','execute','shell','powershell')){$ta=$(try{$args_str|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{@{}}); if($ta.command -match 'rm -rf /|Remove-Item.*-Recurse.*C:\\|Format-Volume|DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE'){@{permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason='Dangerous command blocked by security hook'}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0}}; if($tool -in @('edit','create','write')){$ta=$(try{$args_str|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{@{}}); $fp=if($ta.path){$ta.path}elseif($ta.filePath){$ta.filePath}else{''}; if($fp -match '\.env$|\.env\.|secrets|credentials|\.pem$|\.key$'){@{permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason='Cannot modify sensitive files'}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0}}
preToolUse.comment: Log tool use + block dangerous commands and sensitive file edits
